title: Climate shift 1961-1990 vs 1991-2020 by month for municipalities of France, Portugal, Luxembourg, Serbia
description:
Change in climate between 1961-1990 and 1991-2020 for every municipality of France, Portugal, Luxembourg and Serbia: for each month (1-12) and the annual value, the 1961-1990 value, the 1991-2020 value and the shift, for temperature (degC) and precipitation (percent). One CSV and one Parquet file per country plus a Frictionless datapackage.json.

Method: Copernicus ERA5-Land monthly means (0.1 degree, about 9 km), with ERA5 monthly means (0.25 degree) as fallback where the ERA5-Land cell has no value (coasts). Each municipality takes the nearest grid cell to its reference point (town hall for France, municipal seat for Portugal); values are 30-year means of the monthly values for each of the two periods. These are reanalysis grid-cell values, not station observations: they can differ from official station normals, mostly near coasts, in cities and in steep terrain. Temperatures are adjusted for altitude: each value is moved from the grid cell's model elevation (grid_elevation_m, ERA5-Land orography, ECMWF) to the elevation of the municipality's reference point (elevation_m, from the Copernicus DEM GLO-90) with a fixed lapse rate of 6.5 °C per km: t = t_cell + 0.0065 × (grid_elevation_m − elevation_m). Precipitation is not adjusted. The temperature shift between the two periods does not depend on this adjustment. Built by open scripts in the repository and checked by a validator script.

Places and licences: France, 34,734 communes of metropolitan France and Corsica (INSEE code; overseas departments not included), from the list of communes on data.gouv.fr (Licence Ouverte 2.0); Portugal, 308 municipios (mainland, Madeira, Azores; DICO code), CAOP 2025 of the Direcao-Geral do Territorio (CC BY) with municipal seat coordinates from GeoNames (CC BY 4.0); Luxembourg, 100 communes (LAU code), STATEC LAU codes on data.public.lu (CC0) with GeoNames coordinates (CC BY 4.0); Serbia, 169 municipalities and cities (RZS code), RZS (Statistical Office of the Republic of Serbia) list “Opštine i gradovi”, downloaded 2026-11-13 from https://data.gov.rs/sr/datasets/opshtine-i-gradovi/ under the Serbian Open Data Licence (SODL, commercial reuse allowed with this attribution); modified: coordinates and climate values added with GeoNames coordinates (CC BY 4.0).
